title.en: When does the tractor-driven 4100 match the site?
title.zh: 拖拉机带动4100什么时候对得上现场？

description.en: When there is no pump-motor supply and the line fits 40 kW, 6–12 m³/h, 40–100 m / 15–45 m, aggregate 1–3 cm and slump 180–220 mm.
description.zh: 没有泵用电机电源，且管路落在 40 kW、6–12 m³/h、40–100 m / 15–45 m、骨料 1–3 cm、坍落度 180–220 mm 时。

h1.en: When does the tractor-driven 4100 match the site?
h1.zh: 拖拉机带动4100什么时候对得上现场？

directAnswer.en: When the site has no supply for an electric pump motor and the printed rural window fits. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the Tractor-Driven 4100 for rural self-built houses and short-to-medium pipelines: power cell 40 kW, 6–12 m³/h, 15 MPa, horizontal 40–100 m, vertical 15–45 m, aggregate 1–3 cm, hopper 0.25 m³, slump 180–220 mm, 2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm and 1300 kg. The page does not print a coupling diagram or a fuel rate.
directAnswer.zh: 现场没有电动泵电机的电源，并且已印的农村窗口对得上时。邢台河北品锦机械把拖拉机带动4100列为农村自建房和中短距离管路：功率格 40 kW、6–12 m³/h、15 MPa、水平 40–100 m、垂直 15–45 m、骨料 1–3 cm、料斗 0.25 m³、坍落度 180–220 mm、外形 2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm、1300 kg。这一页没有印连接示意图，也没有印油耗。

heading.en: 40 kW here is not Diesel 40’s 66 kW
heading.zh: 这里的 40 kW 不是柴油40的 66 kW

body.en: Diesel 40 is a 2800 kg trailer at 26 m³/h and 120 m / 360 m. The 4100 is the tractor-driven rural machine. The old slug diesel-4100 on this site redirects to the 4100 page. Order from the tractor page’s cells, not from a Diesel 40 assumption.
body.zh: 柴油40是 2800 kg 拖泵，26 m³/h、120 m / 360 m。4100 是拖拉机带动的农村机器。本站旧地址 diesel-4100 会转到 4100 页面。按下单的是拖拉机页上的格子，不是柴油40的假设。

heading.en: Slump is printed only on this compact diesel page
heading.zh: 坍落度只印在这台紧凑柴油页上

body.en: 180–220 mm is a 4100 cell. Do not copy it onto the 17 kW rural diesel or onto Electric 15. If your mix slump is outside that printed band, say so to Xingtai instead of ignoring the cell.
body.zh: 180–220 mm 是 4100 的格子。不要抄到 17 kW 农村柴油泵或电动15上。如果配合比的坍落度不在这个已印区间里，告诉邢台，不要把这一格略过。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Say tractor-driven, and include slump if you know it. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请写明拖拉机带动，如果知道坍落度也一并写上。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

question.en: Does the outline fit a narrow lane?

answer.en: The printed size is 2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm and 1300 kg. Compare that with the opening you measured. This page does not add a lane width.
answer.zh: 已印尺寸是 2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm、1300 kg。拿它和你量到的通道比。本页不另加路宽。

question.en: Is output 6–12 m³/h a site promise?

answer.en: No. It is the theoretical output cell.
answer.zh: 不是。它是理论输送量格。

answer.en: No. The only short boom in the compact list is on B500S-83D, and that unit is electric.
answer.zh: 不含。紧凑名单里唯一的短臂架在 B500S-83D 上，而且那台是电动的。
